# Cncf Google Container Registry Reviewer

Review Google Container Registry using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Container Registry category. Container Registry is a single place for your team to manage Docker images, perform vulnerability analysis, and decide who can access what with fine-grained access control.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
